sources.description: According to The Denver Post’s Parker Gabriel, the Denver Broncos are re-signing tight end Nate Adkins to a one-year deal. Adkins was a restricted free agent, and instead of placing a tender on him, they signed him to a one-year deal likely worth less than the tender. Earlier this evening, it was reported that the […]
